import RamanujanPV.PackedSieveByteTail
namespace RamanujanPV.PackedSieveSealedMillion
open PackedSieveKernel PackedSieveByteCount PackedSieveByteTail
set_option maxRecDepth 1000000
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
def bits : Nat := 
theorem packed_bits : primeBits 38358837684 1000000 = bits := by decide +kernel
theorem raw_byte_result : byteCount 125000 (primeBits 38358837684 1000000) = 40916 := by
  rw [packed_bits, ←byteCountFast_eq]
  decide +kernel
#print axioms packed_bits
#print axioms raw_byte_result
end RamanujanPV.PackedSieveSealedMillion
